test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In a certain language,

A & B means A is the wife of B,

A ÷ B means A is the daughter of B,

A × B means A is the son of B,

A + B means A is the sister of B and

A @ B means A is the father of B.

P & Q @ L + T & U @ V

Based on the above, how is Q related to V?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 
 A is
 
 

 **Symbol**
 &
 ÷
 ×
 +
 @
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Daughter
 Son
 Sister
 Father
 
 

 
 to B
 
 

Given: P & Q @ L + T & U @ V

P & Q → P is the wife of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25ac4c8c9a87c9965718739dda0b168d266f24e2c6aa9829a6ff17d2d159bf8b.png] 

Q @ L → Q is the father of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c84b63abb4b785dd2ac6ea2fe80e3eafe35a8c187adcb568451fa8243071b35c.png] 

L + T → L is the sister of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75daac2ff32eb56f8b15970ff1db07c2b483268731b26b3c7fdd21debab80c50.png] 

T & U → T is the wife of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4831541a7fa99ba610ea9328ab75e2c7fc8892a8997d8e3b92c7e2e75f205f5.png] 

U @ V → U is the father of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6005c1b934f6cd7759ac40e58fa2a3261a3c251ad3cebbaccb10b928c47c8ef.png] 

Thus, Q is V's maternal grandfather or mother's father.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
